title: A keyed quote occurs once in its passage
statement: Check in code that every keyed quotation occurs exactly once in its passage, since a quotation that recurs elsewhere leaves the evidence ambiguous.
example: A quote-integrity gate found one keyed two-word quote repeated inside a later sentence of its passage, and after repair the 55-lesson, 550-item projection passed.
detail: A downstream quote-integrity gate on a Grade 5 course's lesson data rejected one exact-quote collision: a keyed two-word sentence also appeared inside a later sentence of the same passage. The source was repaired without changing the keyed span, the bound quote then occurred exactly once, and the 55-lesson, 550-item projection passed. A check of exactness alone would have passed it, since the quote was exact; it was not unique.

evidence.quote: - The downstream Course JSON quote-integrity gate exposed and rejected one exact-quote collision in `G5-U7L3-I05`: `U7L3-S23` (`then stops.`) was duplicated inside `U7L3-S30`. The source was repaired without changing the keyed span; the bound quote now occurs exactly once, and the 55-lesson/550-item projection passes.
